expect_red: a session correction leaves one standing binding, the corrected one, and one earlier

mutations.contract: The browser's fold hides the superseded binding and keeps it as history, as build_projection does.
mutations.note: Without the move a corrected binding keeps standing and the row shows both ends bound. The fold moved to apps/viewer/identity_fold.js on 2026-11-12 (one fold for both apps); AA.addEventToRecord delegates to it. Since 2026-11-12 (a_feature_is_bound_once_to_a_set_of_faces) the superseded binding may sit in another record (a feature's correction of an edge end's binding), so the take is on `sup`, the record the named event was folded into.
